observation: Canonical orientation is healthy (h-ring correlation 0.982 and invariant pass), but the 35.0 cm recentring residual is far above the healthy scale and coincides with 25.9 degrees of phase incoherence, 25.9% depth NaNs, and broad curved coverage gaps in the unrolled map. Detection still returns the expected ring count, yet 60% of prompts are fallback-derived and their x-spacing is irregular (CV 0.566), so downstream tuning would be confounded by the upstream unroll.
failure_mode: Stage-1 centre-curve under-fit / marginal robust fit distorts the cylindrical unroll, causing nonuniform radial coverage and unstable downstream prompt geometry.
rationale: Because stage1 is unlocked and the centreline residual is the dominant defect, this round targets the centre curve before Hough or SAM geometry. Denser slicing supplies more centre samples, a stricter RANSAC threshold rejects tube-contaminated or eccentric slice centres, and degree 3 gives the long-span curved tunnel one additional degree of freedom. The radial gate is held at the T4 prior rather than widened to cosmetically fill holes.
